product-name.purpose: The word Parry in the header. Nothing else uses this size.

state-title.purpose: Titles of empty, error and rate-limit states.

count.purpose: Tabular player count leading each row.

label.purpose: Column headers, status note, field labels. Sentence case.

identifier.purpose: Instance IDs and join links only.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Secondary buttons and the checked sort segment.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Notices, toasts, caret rotation, slot fill (clip-path).

components.name: Join Button
components.description: Per-row primary action. Tinted at rest, solid ice when its row is engaged.
components.css: .ds-join { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(143 205 242 / 0.38); background: rgb(143 205 242 / 0.12); color: #8fcdf2; font: 600 13px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-join:hover, .ds-join:focus-visible { background: #8fcdf2; color: #08141c; border-color: transparent; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25) inset, 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.11); background: #17181c; color: #eceef2; font: 500 13px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03) inset, 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); transition: background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #1d1f24; border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fcdf2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Instance ID search with a slash keycap.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 240px; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.11); background: #0c0d0f; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: rgb(143 205 242 / 0.38); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(143 205 242 / 0.12); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; border: 0; background: none; color: #eceef2; font: 13px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #858b95; } .ds-search kbd { font: 10.5px 'Geist Mono', monospace; color: #a9aeb7; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.11); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 4px; background: #17181c; }

components.name: Sort Segmented Control
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.11); background: #0c0d0f; } .ds-seg button { height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: #a9aeb7; font: 500 13px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #eceef2; } .ds-seg button[aria-checked=true] { background: #1d1f24; color: #eceef2; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03) inset, 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); }

components.name: Slot Strip
components.description: Signature: one tick per player slot; grey taken, ice open.
components.css: .ds-slots { --w: 210px; --step: calc(var(--w) / var(--slots)); --gap: calc(var(--step) * 0.4); position: relative; display: inline-block; width: var(--w); height: 10px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(143 205 242 / 0.8) 0 calc(var(--step) - var(--gap)), transparent calc(var(--step) - var(--gap)) var(--step)); } .ds-slots span { position: absolute; inset: 0; clip-path: inset(0 calc((1 - var(--taken)) * 100%) 0 0); background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #5b606b 0 calc(var(--step) - var(--gap)), transparent calc(var(--step) - var(--gap)) var(--step)); }

components.name: Warning Notice
components.description: Rate limit or saved-copy banner above the table.
components.html: Roblox is rate-limiting new requests. Showing the most recent saved copy.
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(230 189 115 / 0.22); background: rgb(230 189 115 / 0.1); color: #a9aeb7; font: 13px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-notice strong { color: #eceef2; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: Parry is a working tool people open dozens of times a week to find a Blade Ball trading server and join it. It looks like a careful desktop app, not a website: one charcoal panel holds the toolbar, the server table and a status bar, and nothing competes with the list. The identity comes from precision and one signature device, not from decoration. Each server's capacity is drawn as a row of slot ticks, so a half-empty lobby is visible before you read any number.
keyCharacteristics: One panel, one table, one accent. The list is usable on first paint.
Four-step cool charcoal ladder plus 1px hairlines carry all hierarchy.
Icy blue means three things only: open slots, the Join action and selection/focus.
Numbers are tabular Geist. Monospace is reserved for identifiers (instance IDs, links).
Every state is designed: skeleton, refreshing, empty, no match, failure, rate limit, saved copy, vanished instance, launch attempt.

rules.name: The Room Rule
rules.body: Ice marks room and action. It never decorates headings, borders of static containers or icons that do nothing.

rules.name: The Unavailable Rule
rules.body: A metric the API does not report renders as a muted "n/a" with a tooltip, never as 0.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase eyebrows, no tracked micro-labels. Column headers and labels are sentence case at 12px in Text 3.

rules.name: The No Dash Rule
rules.body: Copy uses periods, commas and colons. No em or en dashes as punctuation.

rules.name: The Ladder Rule
rules.body: 2px ticks, 4px keycaps and small tags, 6px segments and icon buttons inside controls, 8px buttons and inputs, 12px panels and toasts. Nothing is pill-shaped.

dos: Do keep the table as the first thing on screen at every size.
Do show missing data as unavailable and label snapshots as snapshots.
Do use ice only for room, Join, selection and focus.
Do use tabular Geist for every compared number.
Do keep every interactive control at least 44px tall on touch.
donts: Don't add a hero, marketing heading, feature cards or "best server" badges.
Don't introduce a second accent, gradients, glass, glows or neon.
Don't fabricate regions, latency from the visitor, server age or trade activity.
Don't use monospace for numbers, labels or headings.
Don't put uppercase eyebrows above sections.
